title: Local console access policy
responsibility: Admits local owner requests only when owner mode, loopback binding and the actual peer address all qualify.

inputs.name: loopbackAddress.address
inputs.description: Possible loopback address; undefined becomes empty, then whitespace is trimmed and casing normalized.

inputs.name: consolePolicy.owner
inputs.description: Owner configuration: mode must be loopback, bind must match a loopback address, and no nonblank addressHeader may be configured.

outputs.name: loopbackAddress
outputs.description: True for localhost, ::1, and supported 127.* IPv4 or IPv4-mapped forms after normalization.

outputs.name: consolePolicy
outputs.description: Policy returning true only for an enabled loopback owner server whose request supplies a matching getClientAddress result. Missing or throwing address lookup denies access; client headers are ignored.
